title: Stable influence bound from variance
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a real-valued function on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ with variance at most $1$, and let $0<\\delta\\le 1$. Then the total stable influence of $f$ at parameter $1-\\delta$ is at most $1/\\delta$.
hypotheses_covered: The variance of $f$ is at most $1$
